title: OPSC Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 46 Assistant Executive Engineer Posts
description: The Odisha Public Service Commission (OPSC) has declared the latest job notification for 46 Assistant Executive Engineer Jobs. Candidates who have completed their B.E/ B.Tech in Civil Engineering can use this chance and apply for these posts. Here we mention more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply for the OPSC Notification 2026 before the last date....
